RegArch.inputs: shared RNA, ATAC-derived prior, and full fate map

Random.implementation: seeded independent Uniform(0,1) score for every edge
Random.inputs: shared evaluation edge identifiers only; no truth labels or observations
Random.limitation: expected AUPRC equals edge prevalence and expected AUROC is 0.5

CellOracle.inputs: shared leaf RNA and ATAC/motif-derived base GRN

SCENIC.implementation: GRNBoost adjacency followed by SCENIC-style cis pruning
SCENIC.inputs: shared leaf RNA, synthetic motif hits, peak-gene links, and ATAC
SCENIC.limitation: not the full pySCENIC cisTarget/AUCell workflow; synthetic TFs have no genome ranking database

SCENICplus.implementation: SCENIC+ 1.0a2 build_grn with a truth-blind motif/region/gene candidate eGRN fallback
SCENICplus.inputs: shared leaf RNA/ATAC and generated cistromes/region-gene links
SCENICplus.limitation: small synthetic networks may yield no native GSEA-retained eRegulons; fallback scores combine only the supplied motif, region-gene, and TF-gene evidence

FigR.implementation: FigR 0.1.0 getDORCScores plus synthetic motif scoring
FigR.inputs: shared paired leaf RNA/ATAC, motif hits, and peak-gene links
FigR.limitation: synthetic annotations replace organism motif databases

Pando.inputs: shared paired leaf RNA/ATAC and generated motif/link design
Pando.limitation: synthetic annotations bypass Seurat/Signac genome annotation

GRaNIE.implementation: GRaNIE-compatible TF-peak and peak-gene correlation scoring
GRaNIE.inputs: shared paired leaf RNA/ATAC, motif hits, and peak-gene links
GRaNIE.limitation: not native GRaNIE object construction because synthetic genes cannot be resolved through Ensembl

LINGER.inputs: shared paired leaf RNA/ATAC and generated TF-region/region-gene matrices
LINGER.limitation: matched-information mode without an external atlas

Dictys.inputs: shared leaf RNA and ATAC-derived square edge mask
Dictys.limitation: static reconstruction run independently per leaf

scMTNI.inputs: shared leaf RNA, ATAC-derived priors, and a leaf-only projected tree
scMTNI.limitation: latent ancestors are omitted because scMTNI requires expression at every supplied tree node
